key_findings: GIGA-Lens 2.0 is now public: arXiv:2606.30633 (Huang et al., June 2026, 21pp) scales gigalens to 128 nodes / 512 A100 GPUs (~100x over 1.0), applied to 100 simulated systems + DESI J238.5690+04.7276. Abstract focus is throughput/scaling only - no correlated-noise likelihood, no PSF systematics treatment, no sampler benchmarking - so our two campaign results are complementary to (not superseded by) the flagship paper.

Correlated-noise novelty check: NO published strong-lens-modeling likelihood with a drizzle covariance was found. The substructure power-spectrum line (arXiv:2302.00480) deliberately models unstacked flt frames to AVOID drizzle because 'a dense covariance matrix... less computationally efficient'; JWST modeling work (Galan et al. El Anzuelo, arXiv:2402.18636, herculens+NIFTy) flags strongly correlated noise in drizzled JWST data and recommends re-assessing uncorrelated-Gaussian assumptions but does not implement a full-covariance likelihood. Our GPU drizzle-covariance likelihood + the real-HST 'necessary but not sufficient' result (191-nat bimodality flip; gamma_binned=1.103+/-0.008 vs 1.433 native, 17 sigma) appears genuinely novel.

Sampler-benchmark novelty check: no systematic multi-sampler benchmark on real ill-conditioned/bimodal lens posteriors exists. Closest work is generic: GGNS (arXiv:2312.03911, gradient-guided nested sampling), microcanonical Langevin ensembles (arXiv:2502.06335, ICLR 2025, BNNs), nautilus used inside TinyLensGpu (arXiv:2503.08586), and TDCOSMO IX (arXiv:2202.11101) which compares modeling CODES not samplers. Our 9-sampler benchmark + two-stage preconditioning + per-basin SMC evidence recipe appears to be the first of its kind for lensing.

Pixelated/regularized sources on GPU (frontier 1): herculens wavelet/pixelated sources remain the JAX standard but are 'unbatched, limiting full GPU utilisation'; NEW June-2026 GP source on ray-guided transformed uniform grids, auto-differentiable, FFT-based, ~2x fewer pixels/dim at equal fit quality, arbitrary power-spectrum regularization (arXiv:2606.30620). Also JAXtronomy, a JAX port of lenstronomy (arXiv:2606.01547), and TinyLensGpu (arXiv:2503.08586, ~2000x likelihood speedup, ~3 min/lens with nautilus). Open: batched survey-scale pixelated sources + principled regularization choice.

PSF reconstruction/marginalization (frontier 2): STARRED wavelet two-channel PSF reconstruction (arXiv:2402.08725) is the TDCOSMO photometry standard; Stone/Legin/Hezaveh group's pixellated PSF posterior sampling with diffusion priors on HST ePSFs (arXiv:2511.19594, Nov 2025) claims 'first meaningful propagation of detailed PSF morphological uncertainty downstream' - but is PSF-only, NOT joint with lens modeling. Open gap: joint PSF+source+mass inference with PSF-uncertainty marginalization inside a lens likelihood - exactly where our residual scale-dependent gamma points.

Neural/SBI lens modeling (frontier 3): NPE beats BNNs and is calibrated to <10% of optimal on 12-param SIMULATED DES-like lenses (arXiv:2501.08524); NPE applied to real STRIDES lensed quasars (arXiv:2410.10123); NPE of line-of-sight+subhalo populations (arXiv:2511.17732); SBI misspecification tests exist generically (arXiv:2412.15100) plus domain-adaptive NPE (arXiv:2410.16347). Open: calibration on REAL data under model misspecification - none of the SBI simulators include drizzle-correlated noise, which our E1/E2 results show biases gamma.

Survey automation (frontier 4): Euclid Q1 ran the PyAutoLens-based Euclid Strong Lens Modelling Pipeline (MGE lens light + Delaunay/Voronoi pixelated source) on Q1 candidates, 336 successfully fit (arXiv:2503.15324 SLDE-A); LEMON neural SIE modeling of Euclid lenses, ~26x speedup (arXiv:2503.15329, A&A July 2026); dolphin fully-automated forward-modeling pipeline (arXiv:2503.22657) delivered the uniform SLACS(34)+SL2S(24) models feeding TDCOSMO 2025. Euclid expects ~170,000 lenses. Open: automation yield (~2/3), uniform noise/PSF treatment at scale.

TDCOSMO systematics (frontier 6): TDCOSMO 2025 milestone paper arXiv:2506.03023 gives H0=71.6+3.9-3.3 (8 TD lenses + Pantheon+; 74.3+3.1-3.7 with SLACS/SL2S external sample) with the mass-sheet degeneracy / radial profile as the dominant systematic, now constrained by JWST/Keck/VLT stellar kinematics; TDCOSMO XXVI uniform modeling of 8 doubles (arXiv:2604.24908); dynamical systematics for TD lenses (arXiv:2602.03934). Per-lens gamma (slope) systematics from PSF/source models - our exact residual - remain a live sub-dominant-but-unbudgeted term.

Joint probabilistic inversion (frontier 8): score-based BLIND joint inference of source + lens mass with diffusion priors (arXiv:2511.04792, Nov 2025) and score-based faint-galaxy posterior sampling ('Echoes in the Noise', Adam et al. 2025) show the Montreal group moving toward full pixel-level joint posteriors; herculens+NIFTy multi-band field inference (arXiv:2402.18636). Nobody yet combines PSF + source + mass + correlated noise in one inference.

Foundation/amortized modeling (frontier 9): AION-1 omnimodal astronomy foundation model (2025) exists but nothing lens-modeling-specific; amortized lens modeling remains SIE-level (LEMON) or simulation-only (NPE work). JWST substructure programs (arXiv:2511.07513 WDM joint arcs+flux-ratios; arXiv:2604.05237 minimum halo mass; arXiv:2410.12987 'substructure, angular complexity, or both?'; arXiv:2502.18571 'DM substructure or source-model systematics?') independently confirm that source-model/PSF systematics masquerading as mass signals is THE contested frontier - corroborating our diagnosis of the residual gamma discrepancy.
open_items: Position paper A (novel, publish-ready claim): first correlated-noise (drizzle-covariance) likelihood for GPU strong-lens modeling with a real-data necessary-but-not-sufficient demonstration; cite 2302.00480 (field avoids drizzle) and 2402.18636 (JWST correlated-noise warning) as motivation; JWST drizzled imaging is the obvious second target since that community has flagged but not solved it.

Position paper B (novel): 9-sampler benchmark on real ill-conditioned/bimodal lens posteriors + two-stage preconditioning + per-basin SMC evidence; no lensing-specific sampler benchmark exists (TDCOSMO IX is a code comparison); GGNS (2312.03911) and MCLMC (2502.06335) are natural extra contenders to add if extended.

Biggest unaddressed gap matching our residual gamma systematic: JOINT PSF + pixelated-source + mass inference under a correlated-noise likelihood. Building blocks now exist separately - GP-RTU differentiable sources (2606.30620), pixellated PSF posteriors with diffusion priors (2511.19594), our whitened drizzle likelihood - nobody has assembled them; this is the strongest next-campaign candidate.

Our campaign used parametric sources; upgrading E2 to a pixelated/GP source (herculens wavelets or RTU-GP, both JAX) is the direct test of whether the 17-sigma gamma_binned vs native discrepancy is source-model systematics.

SBI simulators (2501.08524, 2410.10123 lineage) train on white-noise mocks; injecting our drizzle-correlated-noise mocks into NPE training/calibration would test a known-unmodeled misspecification - cheap, novel follow-on.

GIGA-Lens 2.0 (2606.30633) is out from the collaboration; check whether our correlated-noise kernels and sampler recipe should be upstreamed into the multinode-2025 blessed library, and whether the paper's DESI J238.5690+04.7276 system is a second real-data testbed for the drizzle likelihood.

Parked from our own campaign (memory): scale bimodality + correlated-noise likelihood open items from Foundry-I; P2c Perlmutter matrix + T3 PT reference and P1c E2 tasks still marked in_progress in the task list; P4 report row pending.

Euclid VIS (undrizzled-ish but stacked) and Roman: verify whether the Q1 PyAutoLens pipeline (2503.15324) assumes diagonal noise - if so, a correlated-noise audit of survey-scale automated modeling is an unclaimed niche.

Watch items: TDCOSMO XXVI uniform-modeling series (2604.24908) for whether PSF-error marginalization enters their error budget; A&A version of LEMON (July 2026) for amortized-modeling calibration claims on real Euclid lenses.
evidence_notes: Ecosystem is consolidating on JAX (herculens, JAXtronomy 2606.01547, TinyLensGpu 2503.08586, gigalens) - any new likelihood/source-model code we release should be JAX-first to be adoptable; herculens's known weakness is unbatched GPU execution, which our multinode/batched experience directly addresses.

The JWST correlated-noise flag (2402.18636 and successors) plus the flt-frame workaround (2302.00480) mean the field knows the problem and is paying a heavy modeling-complexity cost to dodge it - a GPU-tractable dense/structured covariance (our whitener approach) is the differentiator to emphasize.

Substructure-inference papers (2410.12987, 2502.18571, 2511.07513) show multi-band modeling is the accepted way to disentangle source/PSF systematics from mass signals - a multi-band extension of our E2 cross-scale test would align with community practice.
SBI calibration results are simulation-only; reviewers will ask for coverage under misspecification - our SBC harness from P1b plus drizzle mocks is reusable evidence infrastructure.

TDCOSMO error budget is dominated by MSD/kinematics, so a gamma-systematics contribution must be framed as per-lens modeling robustness (evidence-based basin selection, PSF marginalization), not as an H0-shifting claim.

arXiv numbering observed through 2607.x confirms searches captured the mid-2026 frontier; key IDs verified by fetch: 2606.30633 (GIGA-Lens 2.0), 2511.19594 (PSF posteriors), 2402.18636 (herculens+NIFTy).

directions.title: E3 kernel/lambda-robustness scan of the binned correlated posterior (cheap first discriminator: is 1.103 a covariance-kernel artifact?)
directions.rationale: E3 is the campaign's one pre-registered gate never run ('follow-on (not run)' in the main.tex thresholds table), and the E1b width-ratio FAIL showed the delta-reg (lambda=0.1) whitener discards information at tent-kernel spectral zeros (sigma_fine/sigma_native=2.45). Before blaming source/PSF for the 17-sigma over-correction (gamma_binned(corr,low)=1.103+/-0.008 vs the 1.433 anchor), the campaign's own attribution logic requires excluding the cheapest alternative: that the number moves with the noise-kernel/regularization choice itself. The fine-low gaming pathology (two sane starts railed to gamma~1.0-1.14 with real-space chi2_pp 72-80 while whitened logp improved) proves whitener construction CAN bias gamma low at MAP level; whether the binned whitener shares a milder version of this bias is untested.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Write the never-written 11_kernel_ablation.py. Data: real v3b binned product (foundry-i cutout_v3b.npz) with the low-basin warm start. Method: build 4-5 whitener variants with cgl/noise.py + cgl/whiten.py — fitted two-component kernel (baseline), analytic drizzle kernel (D2-exonerated arm), and delta-reg lambda in {0.03, 0.1(baseline), 0.3, 1.0} — then rerun the exact P1c recipe per variant: MAP polish -> Laplace definiteness check -> 128-particle tempered SMC (cgl/samplers/bj_smc, e2.py driver, ~51GB/A100, shared-QOS single-GPU jobs). Re-add the exact log|C| constant (Szego gap +179.21 nats for v3b, measured in P1a) so cross-whitener logZ comparisons are valid. Gate (pre-registered): gamma_EPL-mean shift < 0.5 sigma across kernel variants; secondary gate: DlogZ(low vs steep) keeps its sign in all variants (protects the 191-nat H1 headline).
directions.payoff: Verdict either way is decisive and cheap: if gamma_binned drifts with lambda/kernel, the 1.103 over-correction is (at least partly) a whitener-construction artifact and the source/PSF campaign should be re-scoped; if gamma is robust across variants, the covariance model is exonerated and the residual is cleanly pinned on source-model/PSF systematics — plus the H1 basin-flip result gets a robustness certificate it currently lacks. Also mechanistically probes WHY fine-low rails low (open item).
directions.reuses: cgl/noise.py, cgl/whiten.py, cgl/e2.py SMC driver, cgl/samplers/bj_smc, whitener_v3b.npz + noise_kernel_v3b.npz as baseline, foundry-i cutout_v3b.npz + map_v11_v3b warm starts, slurm/e2_* shared-QOS templates, P1a Szego-gap constants
directions.risk: Low technical risk (all machinery exists); main risk is an ambiguous middle outcome (0.5-1 sigma drift) that neither exonerates nor convicts the whitener — mitigate by pre-registering the interpretation bands now.
directions.cost: ~8-15 A100-h (4-5 correlated SMC runs at ~2-3 A100-h each on shared QOS), ~2-3 days including the script; fits inside the ~56 A100-h reserve

directions.title: Injection-recovery on the real drizzle stack: known-gamma end-to-end calibration of the correlated likelihood on REAL noise
directions.rationale: E1a validated the correlated likelihood only on synthetic drizzle mocks (separable-tent, exactly convolutional). But P1a Deviation 2 proved the real 3-dither skycell is SHIFT-VARIANT (render check 2.1-26.7 sigma; no convolutional effective PSF exists), so the stationary-kernel covariance is an approximation exactly on the data where the over-correction appears. No experiment has ever recovered a KNOWN gamma through the full correlated pipeline on the real noise field — the 1.103 vs 1.433 discrepancy is currently uninterpretable without this calibration point.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Data: model-subtracted real v3b residual field (real correlated noise; foundry-i cutout_v3b.npz minus the converged v3b model, or the on-disk model_map_v2d_cold.npy analog for v3b) as the noise realization. Method: render 2-3 injections of EPL(gamma=1.433, theta_E=2.655 — the anchor posterior mean) + the fitted shapelet source through the convention-correct empirical_psf_08.npy with cgl/mocks.py-style rendering, add to the real residual, then run the unmodified P1c pipeline (MAP polish -> correlated 128-particle SMC with whitener_v3b.npz) blind to truth. Gate: median |z(gamma)| < 2 and 68% coverage over injections; report the recovered-gamma bias directly in gamma units. Optional second arm: same injection recovered with the DIAGONAL likelihood, reproducing the E1a artifact on real noise for contrast.
directions.payoff: The single sharpest discriminator available: if the injected 1.433 comes back unbiased, the correlated likelihood is certified calibrated on real shift-variant noise and the 1.103 result MUST be model misfit (source/PSF) — licensing directions 3-4; if it comes back biased low (~1.1), the over-correction is a property of the stationary-kernel approximation on shift-variant drizzle and the fix is a per-region/shift-variant noise treatment, not a source upgrade. Either verdict redirects tens of A100-h correctly.
directions.reuses: cgl/mocks.py (exact drizzle mock generator, <0.05 sigma render gate), cgl/e2.py + bj_smc, whitener_v3b.npz, foundry-i cutout_v3b.npz + empirical_psf_08.npy + hmc_v13_v3b.npz converged model for the subtraction, guards.py chi2_pp gates
directions.risk: Injection realism: adding a model to a model-subtracted residual double-counts nothing but inherits any companion-galaxy misfit (chi2~9-15 region) in the 'noise'; mask the companion region or use it deliberately as a stress arm. Moderate risk the answer is scale-dependent (should eventually repeat at native/fine).
directions.cost: ~6-10 A100-h (2-3 correlated SMC recoveries) + phoenix time for injection rendering; ~3-4 days

directions.title: Pixelated/ridge-regularized source under the correlated likelihood (unpark the P3 source pillar on v3b-low)
directions.rationale: This is the campaign's own stated attribution: main.tex ~line 965 blames 'the source model and PSF... which the shapelet source and stationary-kernel PSF of this campaign do not yet address' for the residual scale dependence (1.816 fine-steep / 1.103 binned-low bracketing 1.433). Three independent findings implicate the source basis specifically: (a) the Rhat~22 killer multimodality is a Sersic-vs-shapelet source-CENTER nuisance degeneracy; (b) foundry-i's model-class systematic — n_max 6->8 moved gamma 1.41->1.31 and was explicitly 'NOT plateaued'; (c) Euclid 102157958's -32% theta_E at equal chi2/px is the etherington2024 source-model systematic in the wild. The pillar was parked by written scope gate, not refuted.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Extend cgl/marg.py: the ridge-marginalization machinery already handles linear amplitudes with the Occam logdet term — swap the 28 shapelet columns for a ~30x30 pixelated source grid with gradient (or curvature) regularization; the correlated whitening conv composes unchanged in front of the linear operator. Data: v3b binned product, low basin, whitener_v3b.npz. Run: MAP polish from map_v11_v3b warm start -> Laplace-definiteness check (the cheap convergence predictor) -> 128-particle correlated SMC over the now-smaller nonlinear parameter set (source-center/shape nuisances largely absorbed into the linear solve — plausibly killing the Rhat-22 mode). Gate: real-space chi2_pp <= shapelet baseline AND regularization strength scanned over >=3 values with gamma reported per value. Success criterion: gamma_binned(corr, pixelated) with sigma ~0.01-0.03 to compare against 1.103 and 1.433. Timebox a 1-day herculens cross-check of the pixelated forward model (the never-executed P1b item — the array-only API was built for exactly this swap).
directions.payoff: Directly answers the successor question to both campaigns: if gamma moves from 1.103 toward 1.433 under a flexible source, source-model systematics are confirmed as the over-correction driver and cross-scale unification becomes reachable; if gamma stays at ~1.10, the source is exonerated and PSF becomes the prime suspect (direction 4). Bonus: a batched JAX pixelated-source + correlated-likelihood implementation fills the literature gap (herculens is unbatched; GP-RTU 2606.30620 has no correlated noise) — publishable regardless of verdict.
directions.reuses: cgl/marg.py + likelihood.py (array-only, parity-gated), whitener_v3b.npz, cgl/zoo/foundry_v3b.py target wrapper, bj_smc + two-stage recipe, foundry-i warm starts, vendored gigalens-sean@58ec9a7 unpatched, /raid/benson/.venvs/cgl
directions.risk: Highest-effort direction (~1-2 weeks impl); pixelated sources can absorb mass-model information (mass-sheet-like degeneracy) making gamma prior-dominated — the regularization-strength scan and the Occam logdet term are the guards; SMC memory grows with the larger linear solve (gradient-checkpointing fallback documented).
directions.cost: ~1-2 weeks implementation on phoenix (free) + ~10-15 A100-h for the correlated SMC production runs

directions.title: PSF-uncertainty marginalization in the correlated likelihood (low-dim empirical-PSF perturbation modes on v3b-low)
directions.rationale: PSF is the co-suspect the campaign named but never manipulated: empirical-PSF uncertainty was never propagated in ANY fit (foundry-i open item); the binned product — exactly where gamma=1.103 lives — carries the documented PSF-representation ceiling (empirical_psf_08.npy round-trip cos capped at 0.872 by undersampling); and foundry-i history proves gamma is violently PSF-sensitive (the delta_pix convention defect alone moved the native chi2 floor 3.4->1.05 and dissolved an ESS saturation). A likelihood that now correctly weights correlated noise will also correctly AMPLIFY any unmodeled PSF misfit — a plausible mechanism for over-correction.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Data: v3b binned product, low basin, whitener_v3b.npz. Method: build a ~8-12 dim PSF perturbation basis from the 30 in-field EPSFBuilder stars (PCA of per-star residuals against empirical_psf_08.npy, via foundry-i 17_build_empirical_psf.py machinery); add the mode coefficients as sampled parameters with priors set by the star-to-star scatter (74-dim -> ~84-dim posterior, well inside what bj_smc handled); rerun MAP polish -> Laplace check -> 128-particle correlated SMC. Gates: (a) render check that the perturbed-PSF model reduces the 2.1-26.7 sigma shift-variance residuals; (b) success criterion: does gamma shift > 0.5 sigma and/or does sigma_gamma inflate enough that [1.103 +/- sigma] approaches the 1.433 anchor? Report the gamma-vs-PSF-mode posterior correlations as the mechanism readout.
directions.payoff: Quantifies for the first time how much of the 17-sigma discrepancy PSF uncertainty can absorb — if gamma moves toward 1.433 or the error bar honestly inflates to cover it, PSF marginalization becomes the required ingredient for cross-scale unification (and a novel result: literature has PSF-only posteriors, 2511.19594, but no joint PSF+mass inference under any noise model, let alone correlated); if gamma is PSF-insensitive, PSF is exonerated and the source pillar carries the full burden. Feeds directly into the joint PSF+source+mass 'biggest unaddressed gap' identified in the 2026 literature scan.
directions.reuses: foundry-i 17_build_empirical_psf.py + the 30-star field + empirical_psf_08.npy/empirical_psf_04.npy, cgl/likelihood.py (PSF kernel is already an array argument in the array-only API), whitener_v3b.npz, zoo/foundry_v3b.py, bj_smc, Laplace-definiteness gate from metrics/fitting
directions.risk: PSF modes may be degenerate with source-shape nuisances (could re-inflame the Rhat-22 mode — SMC is the mitigation); the PCA basis from only 30 stars may under-span true PSF error; delta_pix convention must be re-asserted per mode (regression-pinned guard exists).
directions.cost: ~1 week impl on phoenix + ~5-10 A100-h for 1-2 correlated SMC runs

directions.title: Supersampled (ss=2) forward rendering at native and binned scale: kill or confirm pixel-undersampling as the scale-dependence driver
directions.rationale: The scale-dependence itself is the anomaly: correlated gammas BRACKET the anchor (fine-steep 1.816 above, binned-low 1.103 below, native prior-pulled ~2.4) and the diagonal data-scale systematic (+/-0.1: 1.29@0.08" -> 1.372@0.065" -> 1.43@native) got WORSE, not better, under the correlated likelihood. The Euclid section independently named PSF/pixel undersampling as a recurring cause (0.85" ring ~1-2 px wide), and the report's own 'documented robust path' is 'super-sampled (x2) modeling' — parked, never run on the HST products. All fits to date render at delta_pix with no sub-pixel integration; if the arc is under-resolved at 0.08"-0.12825", rendering error is scale-dependent by construction — matching the observed bracket signature.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Data: cutout_v2d.npz (native, diagonal likelihood — the pre-registered anchor product) and cutout_v3b.npz (binned, correlated). Method: render the model on a 2x supersampled grid and bin down, feeding the PSF sampled at delta_pix/2 (empirical_psf.npy 27x27@0.065" is the near-exact ss2 kernel for native 0.12825"; empirical_psf_04.npy @0.04" is exact ss2 for v3b@0.08") — rendering on the fine grid then binning, NOT via subgrid_kernel with mismatched delta_pix (the exact foundry-i defect, regression-guarded). Run: (a) v2d native diagonal MAP+HMC refit from hmc_v13_v2d.npz warm state — does the 1.433 anchor itself move under ss2? gate: shift < 1 sigma (0.03); (b) v3b-low correlated SMC under ss2 — does 1.103 move toward the (possibly revised) anchor? Success criterion: ss2 shifts on the two scales that are consistent with closing part of the bracket, or a clean double-null.
directions.payoff: Cheapest test of the only hypothesis that naturally predicts the BRACKET pattern (opposite-sign gamma errors at different pixel scales). A positive result revises the anchor itself and reframes the 17-sigma tension; a double-null retires undersampling and sharpens the source-vs-PSF dichotomy for directions 3-4. Also directly transfers to the Euclid 102020061/102157958 follow-ons (185 more grade-A systems waiting) where undersampling was already hypothesized.
directions.reuses: All four foundry-i cutouts + all four PSF kernels at matched scales (empirical_psf.npy, empirical_psf_04.npy already on disk — no new PSF builds needed), hmc_v13_v2d.npz/map_v11 warm starts, cgl/e2.py + bj_smc + whitener_v3b.npz, foundry-i v2d recipe (~3 A100-h known cost), the delta_pix regression guard
directions.risk: Rendering-path change touches the parity-gated forward model — must re-run the 5 machine-precision parity gates in ss1 limit first; ss2 doubles render cost and SMC memory per particle (drop to ~96 particles or checkpoint, both documented fallbacks); a partial (one-scale-only) shift would be ambiguous.
directions.cost: ~3-5 days impl (rendering + parity re-gate on phoenix) + ~8-12 A100-h (one native HMC refit ~3 A100-h + one-two correlated SMC runs)

directions.title: Make per-basin tempered SMC-with-evidence the default pipeline stage: gradient-checkpointed whitened likelihood + particle-efficiency engineering
directions.rationale: The campaign's own verdict: on the real correlated v3b-low posterior the MAP is a SADDLE (Laplace min_eig -14.85, 5 negative directions) and every PHMC/metric-repair variant froze at R-hat 21-22, while 128-particle tempered SMC converged (lambda->1 in 28 steps, ESS 77-118) AND delivered the 191-nat basin-evidence flip — but memory caps it: the whitening conv inflates the AD tape ~2.8x over diagonal (~400 MB/particle f64; 300 particles OOM'd at 120.4 GB on an 80GB A100). SMC is the working recipe yet currently runs at the edge of feasibility with only 128 particles and no seed-pair sigma on logZ (P2c 'SMC x2 for a sigma on w_steep' was approved but held).
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Wrap the grouped-conv whitened log-density in cgl/likelihood.py with jax.checkpoint (remat) to trade compute for AD-tape memory; verify logp/grad parity vs the unchecked path with the existing 01_parity_harness.py gates (bit-level or <=1e-12 rel). Then rerun the frozen v3b-low correlated SMC config (10_run_e2.py + slurm/e2_smc_canary_v3b_low.slurm, whitener_v3b.npz) at 2 seeds on one shared-QOS A100. Gates: (a) peak memory/particle <=200 MB enabling >=256 particles on 80GB, (b) gamma marginal within 0.5 sigma of the frozen 1.103+/-0.008, (c) seed-pair logZ sigma <=2 nats, (d) cost <=2 A100-h/seed. Free L4 smoke test first on phoenix (respecting the catalogued XLA_FLAGS workarounds — priority-fusion livelock, triton GEMM).
directions.payoff: SMC-with-evidence becomes an affordable routine stage (~2-4 A100-h per lens/product) instead of a heroic one-off: per-basin evidence + converged marginals on every future target, a credible sigma on w_steep (closing the held P2c confirmatory item), and the enabling cost basis for Euclid-scale (185 grade-A systems) and for Directions 2/5. Also directly upstreamable to the gigalens multinode-2025 library.
directions.cost: ~1 day implementation + 4-6 Perlmutter A100-h (shared QOS, fractional billing, backfills same-day); phoenix smoke tests free.
directions.risk: XLA may already partially rematerialize, muting the memory win; jaxlib 0.6.2 remat + priority-fusion interaction is untested (workaround flags catalogued). Fallback: mixed-precision tape or smaller mutation blocks.
directions.reuses: cgl/likelihood.py, cgl/samplers/bj_smc.py, whitener_v3b.npz + noise_kernel_v3b.npz, 10_run_e2.py, slurm/e2_smc_canary_v3b_low.slurm, 24_basin_evidence_v3b.py, 01_parity_harness.py, foundry-i warm starts (map_v11_v3b_*).

directions.title: Saddle-aware initialization: Hessian-definiteness triage + negative-curvature-directed basin census as an automated pre-flight stage
directions.rationale: Two campaign findings compose into a method: (1) Laplace-Hessian definiteness at the MAP predicted PHMC convergence across ALL products (fine-steep min_eig +0.108 mixed; v3b-low -14.85 froze; v3b-steep -6.6e23 catastrophic) — a cheap pre-flight signal never yet automated; (2) chain basin membership is start-determined — the stored 45-low/3-steep HMC occupancy was a START ARTIFACT overturned by per-basin SMC evidence (w_steep~1.0 under diagonal), and Euclid 102020061 sits unconverged on a 0.79-1.28 arcsec theta_E ridge (R-hat 18.8) because 48 random-start chains cannot enumerate its modes ('more chains cannot fix a degeneracy').
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Write a basin-census script: at each frozen zoo target's MAP, eigendecompose the existing Laplace Hessian (30_recipe_e2e.py laplace step; hess_marg_pd.npz on disk), launch perturbed MAP polishes along +/- each negative-curvature eigendirection plus matched random restarts (cgl/fitting.py polish), and cluster endpoints by logp + z-space distance into basins. Targets: T3 (cgl/zoo/foundry_v3b.py, known low/steep truth) and Euclid 102020061 (cgl/zoo/euclid.py). Gates: recover BOTH known v3b basins from <=16 directed restarts (vs 48 random chains that gave a misleading split); on 102020061 isolate >=2 distinct theta_E sub-modes on the ridge that per-basin SMC can then weight. Guard against the known trap: apply the real-space chi2_pp<~3 sanity check to every polished endpoint so gamed-whitener minima are flagged, not counted as basins.
directions.payoff: Completes the working recipe into a mechanical pipeline: MAP -> definiteness triage (spend-HMC-or-go-SMC decision) -> basin census -> per-basin SMC evidence. Resolves the un-quotable Euclid theta_E, feeds Direction 1 with basin-aware starts, and converts 'occupancy != posterior mass' from a cautionary tale into a tool.
directions.cost: Phoenix-only, ~10-20 GPU-h (MAP polishes are cheap); zero A100 budget.
directions.risk: Negative-curvature directions at the saddle may all drain into the same basin (nuisance sub-modes like srcShp.center rather than new science basins); clustering threshold needs tuning against the known v3b ground truth first.
directions.reuses: cgl/zoo/api.py (InitBundle, z-space log_prob), cgl/zoo/foundry_v3b.py + euclid.py, cgl/fitting.py, 30_recipe_e2e.py laplace_evidence step, foundry-i map_v11_* warm starts and hess_marg_pd.npz, cgl/guards.py chi2_pp gate.

directions.title: Flow-within-SMC: fix the neural-transport failure by using the NSF as an SMC mutation/independence proposal instead of flow-space HMC
directions.rationale: GL-NT failed its own pre-registered bars (0.03-0.05x baseline ESS/grad vs >=3x target) with flow-space TRAJECTORY ADAPTATION identified as the specific bottleneck, and flowMC 0.4.5 failed structurally (scalar-MALA local step, 0/6 even at 4x budget) — but the flows themselves were never the diagnosed culprit, and the report explicitly leaves 'flow-space HMC needs re-tuning or an A100 budget' open. Meanwhile tempered SMC works but is particle-hungry (128-particle ceiling, Direction 1). Using a flow as an independence-Metropolis mutation kernel inside SMC sidesteps trajectory adaptation entirely — the exact component that failed — while keeping the exact likelihood as arbiter.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Train the existing NSF (cgl/flows.py) per-basin on converged on-disk draws (T2: the two-stage PHMC chains with ESS 13-22k; T3-low: the 128-particle SMC cloud), then add a flow independence-proposal mutation option to cgl/samplers/bj_smc.py, activated at high-lambda anneal stages. Benchmark on T2 (46-dim cond-1e14) where an exact reference exists. Gates: (a) flow proposal acceptance >=20% at lambda=1 on T2, (b) SMC-with-flow-mutations matches the reference logZ within 2 nats using <=64 particles or <=half the anneal steps, (c) on T3, w_steep within 2 sigma of the per-basin SMC reference. Add pocoMC (the pre-approved, never-run preconditioned-SMC contender; /raid/benson/.venvs/cgl-torch exists) as the external baseline in the same sweep — this simultaneously extends the benchmark zoo.
directions.payoff: If it passes, SMC cost halves (compounding Direction 1) and the benchmark paper's neural-transport negative upgrades into a constructive recipe validated on real saddle/ill-conditioned posteriors — the first such result (no lensing sampler benchmark exists per the 2026 literature scan). If it fails, the benchmark gains a decisive, pre-registered negative on flows-at-saddles plus the missing pocoMC row.
directions.cost: Phoenix (free) for flow training + T2 cells; ~4-8 A100-h for the T3 correlated confirmation.
directions.risk: 74-dim per-basin flows may mode-collapse on the srcShp.center nuisance multimodality (R-hat 22 degeneracy) — mitigate by training per-basin and gating acceptance before spending A100 time; pocoMC torch/JAX interop adds adapter-fidelity work (logp-equality asserts pattern already exists in samplers/common.py).
directions.reuses: cgl/flows.py (NSF), cgl/samplers/bj_smc.py + glnt.py + common.py adapters, converged chains (foundry-i hmc_v13_*.npz, P1c SMC particles in data/results), zoo T2/T3, 22_run_cell.py + 25_pool_benchmark.py harness, /raid/benson/.venvs/cgl-torch.

directions.title: Amortized/SBI hybrid with the exact likelihood as check: NPE calibration under drizzle-correlated-noise misspecification, then importance-correct with the whitened likelihood
directions.rationale: E1a PASSED by demonstrating exactly the misspecification that every published SBI simulator carries: the diagonal likelihood on drizzle-correlated mocks gives median |z(gamma)|=5.84 with cov68=0 — and the 2026 literature scan confirms NPE work (2501.08524 lineage, 2410.10123 real quasars) trains exclusively on white-noise mocks. The campaign uniquely owns both the exact 9-phase separable-tent drizzle mock generator (<0.05 sigma render gate) and the exact GPU correlated likelihood needed to CHECK an amortized posterior rather than trust it.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Generate paired mock sets with 05_gen_drizzle_mocks.py (identical lens params; white-noise vs drizzle-correlated realizations, ~20-50k sims); train a modest NPE (sbi-package NSF head over gamma, theta_E, q, shear — low-dim marginal, not the full 74-dim posterior) on the white set; run the existing E1 SBC/coverage harness on the correlated set, then retrain on correlated mocks and re-test. Finally, importance-reweight the NPE posterior on held-out mocks using the exact whitened likelihood (cgl/likelihood.py). Gates: white-trained NPE demonstrably miscalibrated on correlated mocks (cov68 < 0.5), correlated-trained NPE restores cov68 within the E1 convention band [0.6, 0.76], and importance-weight ESS >= 10% — the qualification bar for using NPE as an SMC initializer/proposal.
directions.payoff: A cheap, novel, publishable misspecification result (no SBI simulator includes drizzle-correlated noise) plus a practical hybrid: a calibrated amortized initializer that feeds Direction 1's SMC and Direction 2's basin census with informed starts, with the exact likelihood always retained as the arbiter — the SBI-done-right pattern reviewers will demand.
directions.cost: Phoenix-only (mock generation + small NPE training fit an L4); ~2-4 days wall time, zero A100 budget.
directions.risk: Low-dim marginal head limits the importance-reweighting claim (weights computed against the marginal, not the joint); sim budget may need to grow beyond 50k for stable coverage estimates. Neither risk touches the headline misspecification result.
directions.reuses: cgl/mocks.py + 05_gen_drizzle_mocks.py, E1 SBC harness (07_run_e1_batch.sh, 08_pool_e1.py, mocks_report*.json baselines), cgl/likelihood.py + whiteners in data/, cgl/metrics.py (axis-bug-pinned diagnostics).

directions.title: Evidence-scored source-complexity ladder: per-basin SMC logZ as the routine model-comparison tool, aimed at the 17-sigma over-correction
directions.rationale: The campaign's headline anomaly is an unadjudicated model-selection problem: H2 FAILED with gamma_binned(corr,low)=1.103+/-0.008 sitting ~17 sigma below the 1.433 native anchor, explicitly attributed to source-model/PSF systematics — and foundry-i already showed raising shapelet n_max 6->8 (+3rd companion Sersic) moves gamma 1.41->1.31 'NOT plateaued' with no evidence arbitration ever run. Simultaneously, the campaign proved per-basin SMC yields trustworthy logZ (191-nat flip; DlogZ=-28.9 correlated) at ~1-2 A100-h/run, and pre-registered that cross-model evidence comparisons MUST carry the exact log|C| constants (Szego gap +179.21 nats on v3b). All ingredients for evidence-based source-ladder selection exist; nobody has composed them.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: On the binned v3b product under the correlated likelihood, run low-basin 128-particle SMC (10_run_e2.py machinery, Direction 1's memory fix if landed) across a 3-rung source ladder: shapelet n_max in {6 (frozen baseline), 8, 10}, warm-started where possible from foundry-i's on-disk map_v11_v2d_nm8c3.npz (n_max=8 + 3rd companion Sersic) analog; include the exact log|C| constant so logZ is cross-comparable; 2 seeds on the leading rung. Gates: seed-pair logZ sigma <=2 nats; then the decision fork — (a) logZ prefers flexibility AND gamma_binned(corr,low) moves >=3 sigma toward 1.433 => source systematic confirmed, green-lighting the parked GP/pixelated-source pillar with evidence in hand; (b) gamma flat across the ladder => suspicion shifts to PSF, redirecting the follow-on before any GP investment.
directions.payoff: The first evidence-based adjudication of the campaign's own open 'why does the correlated likelihood over-correct' question, using only the validated sampler; establishes ladder-plus-per-basin-logZ as the default model-comparison stage for all future model upgrades (GP source, multipoles, companion structure); de-risks the parked P3 pillar for a fraction of its cost.
directions.cost: ~6-10 A100-h of the ~56 h Perlmutter reserve (3 rungs x 1-2 seeds x ~1.5-2 A100-h, shared QOS); cheaper if Direction 1 lands first.
directions.risk: n_max=10 adds dimensions and may re-trigger nuisance multimodality or new saddle structure — mitigated by SMC itself (it crossed the R-hat-22 nuisance) and Direction 2's basin census as pre-flight; ridge-marginalization hyperparameters must be held fixed across rungs for logZ comparability.
directions.reuses: cgl/e2.py + 10_run_e2.py correlated-SMC driver, whitener_v3b.npz + noise_kernel_v3b.npz, cgl/marg.py ridge marginalization, 24_basin_evidence_v3b.py evidence pattern, foundry-i warm starts (map_v11_v2d_nm8c3.npz, map_v11_v3b_*), slurm/e2_prod_shared.slurm shared-QOS template, CAMPAIGN.md ledger discipline.

directions.title: Survey coadd noise-covariance audit: is the drizzle effect as large on LSST/JWST/Roman products?
directions.rationale: The campaign quantified, for the first time on real data, how much a resampling-correlated noise model matters: a 191-nat per-basin evidence flip and a gamma shift from ~1.29 to 1.103 on the binned HST product, while the weakly-correlated native product (rho(1)~0.3-0.5) showed whitening costs information for little benefit. E1a proved the diagonal-likelihood bias is reproducible on mocks with known truth (median |z(gamma)|=5.84, cov68=0). The literature scan confirmed nobody has measured this on other surveys: 2302.00480 avoids drizzle entirely, 2402.18636 flags JWST correlated noise but never implements a covariance, and Euclid Q1 VIS is native/diagonal. The campaign's masked-ACF kernel fitter + mock generator make the audit nearly free.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Data: empty-sky regions of (a) a public JWST NIRCam drizzled mosaic containing a known lens (El Anzuelo field from 2402.18636 lineage, via MAST), (b) an LSST DP1/ComCam i-band coadd patch, (c) a Roman OpenUniverse simulated coadd. Method: measure the noise ACF with cgl/noise.py masked-ACF fitting (the two-component bivariate family already validated against real HST residuals; the plan's simple 2-param family is known-refuted), then inject each fitted kernel into cgl/mocks.py drizzle mocks and refit with the DIAGONAL likelihood via cgl/e1.py, exactly reproducing the E1a protocol. Gate per product: median |z(gamma)| > 2 across mock realizations => product flagged 'correlated likelihood required' and a whitener is built with 03_build_whiteners.py (e_op<=0.02 gate); |z|<1 => documented negative (diagonal is safe, as for Euclid Q1 VIS). Deliverable: a per-survey table of rho(1), kernel parameters, and diagonal-likelihood gamma bias.
directions.payoff: Turns the one-instrument result into a field-wide statement of when the correlated-drizzle likelihood is needed — directly actionable for the Euclid SLDE-A/PyAutoLens pipeline (336 fits, diagonal noise), Rubin lens modeling, and Roman planning; also identifies the second real-data target (JWST is the community-flagged unsolved case) for the position paper the literature scan says is publish-ready.
directions.reuses: /raid/benson/git/agentic-lensing/reproductions/claude-giga-lens/cgl/{noise,mocks,whiten,e1}.py, 02_fit_noise_kernels.py, 03_build_whiteners.py, 05_gen_drizzle_mocks.py, data/noise_kernel_*.npz as fit-quality references, data/euclid IO patterns in cgl/euclid_io.py
directions.risk: LSST/Roman coadds use lanczos warping, not drizzle tent kernels — the two-component family may not fit (the 0.05 ACF-residual gate will catch this); JWST resampling is shift-variant like the NDRIZIM=3 skycell, so the stationary-kernel model is again an approximation; DP1 background structure may contaminate the ACF.
directions.cost: ACF fits are CPU-cheap; mock-injection arms ~5-10 phoenix GPU-h per survey product (E1a-scale); zero Perlmutter A100-h. Total ~2 weeks effort, ~30 phoenix GPU-h.

directions.title: Population deployment: automated diagonal-vs-correlated evidence triage on the Foundry HST lens sample (pilot N=5)
directions.rationale: The campaign's verdict is explicitly one-lens: on DESI-165.4754-06.0423 the binned steep basin was a noise-covariance artifact (191-nat swing) and the correlated likelihood over-corrects gamma by 17 sigma. Whether real HST lens posteriors are GENERICALLY bimodal-by-noise-artifact, and how large the gamma shift distribution is, is unknown — and the campaign built exactly the automation needed: Laplace-Hessian definiteness as the cheap convergence predictor, the chi2_pp<3 / gamma<1.8 post-polish guard gates that saved budget twice, per-basin tempered SMC (128 particles, ~51GB, converged in 28 steps), and the 30_recipe_e2e.py end-to-end pipeline. Euclid P3 additionally showed the recipe transfers to new systems mechanically (COOLEST export 3/3).
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Data: 5 additional HST drizzled lenses from the GO-15867/Foundry DESI follow-up program (MAST DOI 10.17909/hx0v-9260 program pages), chosen for extended arcs. Method per system, fully scripted: foundry-i 17_build_empirical_psf.py ePSF (15x15 at delta_pix, the convention-correct recipe) -> cutout + model-subtracted sky calibration -> 02/03 kernel+whitener with e_op<=0.02 gate -> MAP polish with guard gates -> Laplace definiteness triage -> diagonal AND correlated per-basin SMC evidence via 24_basin_evidence_v3b.py machinery, as Perlmutter shared-QOS single-GPU jobs (same-day backfill, fractional billing), rsync+md5-audited per deploy policy. Gate: >=4/5 systems produce converged SMC (lambda->1, ESS>=96) under both likelihoods at <=3 A100-h/system; report per-system sign(DlogZ) flip rate and Delta-gamma(corr-diag). Pilot budget 15-18 A100-h of the ~56-h reserve.
directions.payoff: Converts 'necessary but not sufficient on one lens' into a population statement — the fraction of HST lens models whose basin selection or slope is noise-model-dependent — which is the number survey pipelines and TDCOSMO actually need; a passing pilot is the quantitative justification for a dedicated NERSC allocation (~300 A100-h for 100 systems) and the natural companion to a GIGA-Lens 2.0-scale application.
directions.reuses: Entire cgl package + slurm/e2_prod_shared.slurm shared-QOS templates, cgl/zoo/api.py LensPosterior abstraction for new targets, 24_basin_evidence_v3b.py, 30_recipe_e2e.py, foundry-i PSF/cutout scripts and *_stats.json noise-calibration recipes, /raid/benson/.venvs/cgl pinned env (zero-drift on Perlmutter)
directions.risk: Per-system babysitting cost is the real bottleneck (the campaign's impl agent died mid-run and stalled P1c 4 days — dead-man monitoring must be built first); heterogeneous NDRIZIM/dither patterns mean some systems will be shift-variant with no good convolutional kernel; 100-system scale-out exceeds the current A100 reserve and must not be promised from the pilot.
directions.cost: Pilot: ~15-18 A100-h (Perlmutter shared QOS) + ~1 week pipeline hardening incl. dead-man monitor; full population contingent on new allocation.

directions.title: Time-delay cosmography impact: propagate the noise-model gamma shift to Fermat potentials, then refit one TDCOSMO lens
directions.rationale: The campaign showed a pure noise-model choice moves gamma_EPL from 1.433 [1.400,1.468] to 1.103+/-0.008 on the same lens — a shift an order of magnitude larger than TDCOSMO's total error budget tolerates, since time delays scale steeply with the local slope. TDCOSMO 2025 (2506.03023) budgets MSD/kinematics as dominant but has NO line item for coadd noise covariance, and all TD lens imaging is drizzled HST/JWST. The campaign also proved the effect is basin/evidence-level (191 nats), i.e. it can silently select the wrong solution family, not just widen error bars.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Step 1 (this week, near-zero cost, no new sampling): load the two existing DESI-165 posteriors — diagonal-native hmc_v13_v2d.npz (the 1.433 anchor, 48ch x 8k) and the P1c correlated binned-low SMC particles — and push both through the differentiable gigalens deflection to compute Fermat-potential differences Delta-phi for synthetic image pairs placed on the system's own critical configuration; report the fractional Delta-t shift between noise models. Gate: predicted |Delta t| shift > 5% (larger than TDCOSMO's full ~4-5% H0 error) => proceed to Step 2: refit one real extended-arc TDCOSMO system's WFC3 drizzle (e.g. one of the TDCOSMO XXVI doubles with prominent arcs) diagonal-vs-correlated with the standard pipeline and quote the measured Fermat shift. Gate for Step 2: shift resolved at >3 sigma_stat on any image pair => unbudgeted systematic paper; <0.3 sigma => bounded negative, equally publishable.
directions.payoff: Either establishes coadd noise covariance as a new, currently-unbudgeted term in the H0 error budget (high-impact, directly relevant to the TDCOSMO series) or bounds it — and the framing follows the literature note: per-lens modeling robustness and evidence-based basin selection, not an H0-shift claim.
directions.reuses: foundry-i data/hmc_v13_v2d.npz + map/warm starts, P1c SMC particle files under reproductions/claude-giga-lens/data/results, cgl/likelihood.py + whiten.py for the Step-2 refit, vendored gigalens-sean@58ec9a7 deflection code, SMC machinery cgl/samplers/bj_smc.py
directions.risk: Step 1 is illustrative (DESI-165 is not a TD lens; synthetic image pairs), so over-claiming is the hazard; Step 2 TD lenses have quasar point sources the gigalens stack does not model — choose an arc-dominated system or mask point images, which weakens the claim; the correlated-binned posterior itself carries the unresolved over-correction, so the honest statement is a SENSITIVITY range, not a corrected value.
directions.cost: Step 1: <1 phoenix GPU-h + 2-3 days analysis. Step 2: ~10-15 A100-h (kernel/whitener + MAP + two SMC runs) + cutout/PSF prep for a new system.

directions.title: COOLEST cross-code validation on the same pixels: herculens/JAXtronomy source-basis swap as the test of the H2 over-correction
directions.rationale: The campaign's own attribution for the H2 failure (correlated gamma 1.103 binned / 1.816 fine-steep BRACKETING the 1.433 anchor) is 'source-model/PSF systematics ... which the shapelet source and stationary-kernel PSF do not yet address', explicitly citing the etherington2024 code-comparison theme; the Euclid P3 -32% theta_E case independently showed Sersic+shapelet selects a different answer than the published free-form pixelized source AT EQUAL pixel fit quality. Meanwhile the timeboxed herculens cross-check promised in the P1b plan was never executed, and the array-only likelihood API plus 3/3 COOLEST round-trips were built precisely to make this swap cheap.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Arm A (parity, days): fit cutout_v2d (native anchor product) with herculens and/or JAXtronomy using a matched shapelet configuration warm-started from map_v11_v2d, exchange via 32_coolest_export.py; gate: theta_E within 1% and gamma within the anchor interval — this retires the never-run cross-check and validates conventions. Arm B (the science): fit binned v3b with herculens' wavelet/pixelated source, composing it with the array-only correlated whitened likelihood from cgl/likelihood.py (both JAX; whitener_v3b.npz on disk), warm-started from the P1c low-basin solution. Gate: if gamma_binned(corr, pixelated source) moves from 1.103 toward 1.433 by >3 sigma, source-model systematics are CONFIRMED as the over-correction driver (and the parked GP/pixelated-source pillar gets its mandate); if it stays ~1.10 under a flexible source, suspicion shifts to the PSF/kernel and the pre-registered-but-never-run E3 lambda/kernel-variant scan becomes the next gate. Extend to the 3 Euclid targets (posteriors + COOLEST exports on disk) for the multi-code population point.
directions.payoff: Directly adjudicates the campaign's headline open question (which of source model / PSF / kernel drives the 17-sigma over-correction) with an independent code, produces the field's first cross-code comparison under a correlated-noise likelihood, and yields a reusable herculens<->cgl bridge — the exact 'joint PSF+source+mass under correlated noise' gap the literature scan flags as unclaimed.
directions.reuses: cgl/likelihood.py (array-only, parity-gated), data/whitener_v3b.npz + whitener_v2d.npz, 32_coolest_export.py + data/coolest/, foundry-i map_v11_* warm starts and empirical_psf_*.npy, Euclid fits data/euclid/*_posterior.npz, phoenix L4s (herculens is JAX; no A100s needed)
directions.risk: Herculens is unbatched on GPU (known weakness) so pixelated-source sampling may be slow — MAP+Laplace comparison may have to substitute for full posteriors; source-regularization strength becomes a new free choice (use herculens defaults + one sensitivity step); convention mismatches (ellipticity/PA, the foundry-i mirrored-PA trap) must be caught by Arm A before Arm B is interpretable.
directions.cost: Phoenix-only: ~30-60 GPU-h across arms plus ~1-2 weeks integration effort; zero Perlmutter A100-h.

directions.title: Drizzle-free arbiter: joint multi-exposure (flt-level) likelihood on DESI-165 to settle which gamma is the artifact
directions.rationale: The campaign left gamma genuinely unresolved: correlated slopes bracket the anchor (1.103 binned-low vs 1.816 fine-steep vs 1.433 diagonal-native), the real 3-dither skycell is provably SHIFT-VARIANT (render check 2.1-26.7 sigma — no convolutional effective PSF exists, so the stationary-kernel correlated model is itself an approximation), and the fine whitener is gameable. Modeling the 3 individual flt exposures jointly makes the noise TRULY diagonal per exposure and eliminates drizzle from the forward model entirely — the strategy 2302.00480 uses to dodge exactly this problem. Crucially, the campaign already built and validated the exact 9-phase separable-tent 3-frame mock machinery (mocks_report_3frame.json, <0.05-sigma render gate), so multi-frame rendering is partly de-risked.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Data: the 3 WFC3/IR F140W flt frames of GO-15867 for DESI-165 (MAST DOI 10.17909/hx0v-9260), with per-exposure ERR arrays and WCS dither offsets. Method: extend cgl/e2.py to a joint likelihood logL = sum over 3 exposures of diagonal Gaussians, rendering the SAME lens+source model onto each exposure's native grid with per-exposure sub-pixel offsets and the convention-correct 15x15 delta_pix ePSF (empirical_psf_13.npy recipe); validate the renderer first on the existing 3-frame mocks with known truth (gate: recover injected gamma with |z|<1, the E1-style pass). Then MAP polish from map_v11_v2d and both-basin tempered SMC (the only tool proven to converge these posteriors). Science gate: the flt-level gamma posterior separates 1.103 vs 1.433 at >5 sigma by construction of the current error bars — whichever it lands on, one of the two campaign numbers is demoted to processing artifact; chi2_pp<=1.3 per exposure required for the verdict to count.
directions.payoff: Settles the campaign's central open mystery (the 17-sigma over-correction) with a measurement that has NO resampled-noise assumption at all, validates or overturns the foundry-i anchor, and — through the survey lens — prototypes exposure-level joint modeling, the architecture Rubin/Roman will need anyway since their coadds are shift-variant; natural follow-on is multi-band joint fits (Euclid VIS+NISP on the Q1 trio) using the same summed-likelihood pattern, the community-accepted way to break source/PSF-vs-mass degeneracies.
directions.reuses: cgl/mocks.py 3-frame drizzle generator + mocks_report_3frame.json validation, cgl/e2.py + samplers/bj_smc.py SMC (128-particle config known to fit 80GB; per-exposure diagonal likelihood is CHEAPER than the whitened one, ~145MB/particle), foundry-i empirical PSF pipeline + cutout_F140W.fits provenance, map_v11_v2d warm start, guards.py incident gates
directions.risk: Highest implementation risk of the five: WCS/geometric-distortion registration errors would masquerade as PSF/source systematics (mitigate via the mock-truth gate before touching real data); flt frames carry cosmic rays/persistence/bad pixels needing masks; 3 exposures at native IR sampling are PSF-undersampled, so the answer may be PSF-representation-limited (the documented cos-0.872 ceiling) — in which case the result degrades to bounding, not settling.
directions.cost: ~1-2 weeks implementation + mock validation on phoenix (~20 GPU-h), then ~10-15 A100-h for real-data MAP + two-basin SMC; fits inside the ~56 A100-h reserve.

directions.title: E3 kernel-misspecification scan: does gamma_binned(corr,low)=1.103 survive covariance-kernel variants?
directions.rationale: This is the campaign's one deliberately-unrun pre-registered gate ('E3 robustness: gamma-mean shift < 0.5 sigma across kernel variants — follow-on (not run)', main.tex thresholds table line ~1478). The headline over-correction (1.103 +/- 0.008, 17 sigma below the 1.433 anchor) is attributed to source/PSF systematics, but that attribution is only defensible if the result is first shown robust to the noise-kernel choice itself — the fitted two-component kernel was adopted because the plan's 2-param family failed its 0.05 fit gate (real residuals have pedestals, anisotropic cores, v2d column stripes), so kernel choice is a live degree of freedom. A rigor culture that pre-registers gates has to run them; this is also the cheapest discriminator between 'covariance misspecification' and 'source/PSF' explanations of the bracket.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Commit the dangling working tree (10_run_e2.py, cgl/e2.py, slurm/e2_*), then build 3 whitener variants for the v3b binned product with 03_build_whiteners.py: (a) production fitted two-component kernel (control, whitener_v3b.npz), (b) analytic-drizzle-only kernel (cgl/noise.py drizzle_acf, no fitted excess), (c) binned_kernel_from_fine(cov_fine) propagated from the v3 fit. Verify each passes the e_op <= 0.02 gate, then rerun the exact production 128-particle correlated SMC (e2.py, slurm/e2_prod_shared.slurm, shared-QOS single-GPU) on v3b-low per variant. Gate (pre-registered): |shift in gamma mean| < 0.5 sigma (0.004) across variants; any cross-whitener evidence comparison MUST re-add the exact log|C| constants (Szego gap +179.21 nats on v3b; cross-check small-grid with exact_ref.py dense Cholesky). Deploy hygiene: rsync + md5-audit remote .py before the first job.

directions.title: Known-truth source-complexity-mismatch mock: can source misspecification reproduce the bracket signature?
directions.rationale: The campaign's central open claim — 'residual scale dependence points to source-model/PSF systematics' — is stated in the report but has NO designed experiment (ledger open item: 'No experiment designed yet'). There is supporting circumstantial evidence that source flexibility moves gamma at the right magnitude (foundry-i: n_max 6->8 + third Sersic moved gamma 1.41->1.31, not plateaued), and the campaign's own E1a set the precedent that an artifact must be reproduced with known truth before it is attributed (median |z(gamma)|=5.84 reproduced the diagonal artifact on mocks). The bracket pattern (fine-steep 1.816 ABOVE the 1.433 anchor, binned-corr-low 1.103 BELOW) is a distinctive falsifiable signature: test whether truncated-source fitting generates it.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Generate 8 drizzle mocks with cgl/mocks.py at truth gamma = 1.433 where the TRUE source has structure outside the production shapelet basis (n_max=12 source rendered, fit with production n_max; plus a clumpy two-component variant), and 8 control mocks with matched (representable) sources. Fit each arm at binned scale with the correlated likelihood (production SMC) and at fine scale with the diagonal likelihood (two-stage PHMC recipe, steep-basin start). Pre-registered gate: mismatch mocks show the directional signature — median z(gamma) < -3 on binned-corr AND > +3 on fine-diagonal — while controls sit at |z| < 1. Sanity-guard with guards.py chi2_pp gates so whitened-logp gaming is caught in real space.
directions.payoff: If the signature reproduces, source misspecification is promoted from hypothesis to demonstrated mechanism, and the parked GP/pixelated-source pillar (RTU-GP or herculens wavelets, both JAX) becomes the justified flagship follow-on with a mock-validated acceptance test. If it does NOT reproduce, source-model work is deprioritized before burning its ~15 A100-h envelope and PSF (the shift-variant NDRIZIM=3 approximation) becomes prime suspect — either outcome redirects the biggest open question of both campaigns.
directions.reuses: cgl/mocks.py exact 9-phase drizzle generator (render gate < 0.05 sigma), e1.py/e2.py drivers, whitener_v3b.npz, guards.py, two-stage PHMC recipe + bj_smc, foundry-i map_v11_* warm starts for realistic lens/source parameters, phoenix for diagonal arms
directions.cost: Mock generation + diagonal fine fits: phoenix, free (~30-50 GPU-h). Correlated binned SMC: 16 runs x ~1 A100-h = ~16 A100-h; can halve by running mismatch arm first and gating the control arm
directions.risk: One specific mismatch family failing to reproduce the signature does not exhaust source misspecification (it bounds, not proves, the negative); mitigate by pre-registering the two mismatch families up front and reporting both as honest outcomes

directions.title: Whitener regularization as part of the model: the pre-registered lambda arm and the fine-low bias mechanism
directions.rationale: Two characterized-but-unexplained pathologies implicate the delta-regularization choice (lambda=0.1) at the tent kernel's spectral zeros: (1) E1b width-ratio sub-gate FAIL sigma_fine/sigma_native = 2.45 ('conservative, not biased'), and (2) the fine-low whitener is outright GAMED — polish rails gamma 1.369 -> 1.021 while whitened logp improves and real-space chi2_pp climbs 30.7 -> 71.9, with two independent sane starts railing low. The lambda-sensitivity arm was pre-registered as the designed probe (E1b amendment, 2026-07-08) and never run. A likelihood whose ordering disagrees with real-space residuals at some hyperparameter setting is a rigor problem regardless of which products are excluded; fixing or profiling it either unlocks the never-obtained fine-low correlated posterior (the missing cell of the cross-scale bracket) or converts the exclusion into a mechanistic theorem.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: Local, mostly forward-pass cost: rebuild v3 fine whiteners at lambda/s_floor in {0.01, 0.03, 0.1 (production), 0.3, 1.0} via whiten.py build_whitener (adaptive-floor path exists; hard-floor bias is a pinned trap), and at each lambda evaluate whitened logp WITH the exact log|C(lambda)| constant (exact_ref.py dense Cholesky on subgrids to anchor the Szego correction) plus real-space chi2_pp at three fixed parameter points: sane v3b-low start (gamma 1.277), railed point (gamma ~1.02), and anchor-like (gamma 1.433). Gate: exists lambda* where the whitened-logp ordering of the three points matches the chi2_pp ordering (gaming cured) AND mock E1b width ratio at lambda* falls in the pre-registered [0.7, 1.5]. Only if the gate passes: one fine-low MAP-polish + SMC attempt at lambda*.
directions.payoff: Resolves the open 'fine-low bias mechanism' item with a quantitative story (information discard at spectral zeros vs genuine bias), potentially recovers the fine-low correlated gamma — completing the 2x2 scale/basin table that currently drives the bracket interpretation — and establishes a transferable rule for when near-singular upsampled covariances are whitenable at all (directly relevant to any JWST drizzle follow-on, where the field has flagged but not solved correlated noise).
directions.reuses: cgl/whiten.py (build_whitener s_floor machinery), cgl/exact_ref.py, whitener_v3.npz + noise_kernel_v3.npz, foundry-i cutout_v3.npz, stored railed/sane MAP points from the P1c discriminator jobs (data/results, diag_jobs.tsv), guards.py chi2_pp gates
directions.cost: Sweep + orderings: local CPU/L4, < 1 day, no A100 hours; conditional fine-low SMC attempt ~2-4 A100-h
directions.risk: Larger lambda may cure gaming only by discarding so much fine-scale information that the fine-low posterior is prior-pulled like correlated-native (info-poverty finding); the gate's width-ratio arm is designed to catch exactly that failure mode

directions.title: Test stationarity before assuming it: per-region kernel homogeneity on the shift-variant skycell
directions.rationale: The campaign proved the real v3 skycell (NDRIZIM=3) is SHIFT-VARIANT — no convolutional effective PSF exists (render check 2.1-26.7 sigma, P1a Deviation 2) — yet every whitener built is a stationary convolutional kernel; the report explicitly carries 'stationary-kernel model is itself an approximation on real data' as a caveat, and the kernel fits already showed spatial structure the stationary family strains to absorb (medium-scale pedestals, v2d column stripes). The fine-low pathology appears exactly at 3.2x upsampling where phase-dependent drizzle overlap is strongest, so stationarity breakdown is a candidate contributor to both the whitener gaming and the residual over-correction. Rigor demands the assumption be tested with a quantitative reject/accept gate rather than carried as prose.
directions.concrete_first_experiment: CPU-only, launchable today: partition the model-subtracted v3 (fine) and v3b (binned) residual fields into a 3x3 block grid, estimate per-block ACFs with cgl/noise.py masked_acf_2d and fit per-block two-component kernels with fit_kernel2; bootstrap each block's kernel parameters by residual resampling. Gate: per-block parameters (w_d, sig_e*, w_b, sig_b*) mutually consistent within 2 sigma bootstrap bands -> stationarity survives at current sensitivity, caveat quantified and closed; inconsistent -> stationarity REJECTED with a measured amplitude, and the follow-up is a block-diagonal (per-region whitener) likelihood variant built from existing build_whitener calls, added as an extra arm of the E3 scan on v3b-low SMC.
directions.payoff: Either retires the shift-variance caveat with numbers (strengthening the kernel-robustness case for 1.103) or discovers that the noise model class itself — not just its kernel — is misspecified, which would reframe the over-correction before any expensive source-model campaign and would be the first quantified non-stationarity treatment in a drizzle-covariance lens likelihood (no published competitor exists per the 2026 literature check).
directions.reuses: cgl/noise.py (masked_acf_2d, fit_kernel2, drizzle_overlap_matrix_1d for the phase-dependence prediction), foundry-i cutout_v3.npz/cutout_v3b.npz + model_map artifacts for model subtraction, cgl/whiten.py for per-region whitener builds, e2.py SMC only in the conditional follow-up
directions.cost: Stage 1 is pure CPU statistics (~1-2 days effort, zero GPU); conditional per-region-whitener SMC arm ~2 A100-h piggybacking on the E3 scan
directions.risk: 3x3 blocks on a 260x260 field give noisy per-block ACFs, so the test may lack power (an accept is 'not rejected at current sensitivity', not proof); the drizzle_overlap_matrix_1d phase prediction provides an independent theoretical cross-check to sharpen it
